author: Lisa Sasha
text: Jason was readily available and helpful, thorough and left my septic 1000 times better than when he arrived. I am thankful for the small town family feel and will definitely call him to maintain it from now on.

author: Amanda Sproles
text: Went above and beyond. I currently use a warranty company.  Sidekick went above and beyond the trouble of getting approved with  warranty company.  Multiple frustrating calls from the both of us to warranty company. Sidekick hung in there with me. After finally getting approved Sidekick’s communication was spot on I was out of town and I knew when they were at my house, when they left, and when they would return. They gave me pointers on when to do what in the future. I would highly recommend Sidekick. Thank you again for everything

author: The Tree Trimmer
text: Excellent same day service very informative and took the time to help locate the tank. Clean up well after his self and didn't try to sell me on things I didn't need unlike some other people In the past. This company will be our go to for now on. Thank you again

author: Jonathan Ketron
text: Jason was friendly and very informative on the options that I have to choose from on replacing/repairing my septic system. I am very pleased with the experience and thankful that he was able to get me put on his schedule quickly and while it was cold and pouring snow.

author: Shawn Anthony
text: Sidekick Septic was called to pump my septic tank due to an issue I was experiencing inside my home. Jason arrived exactly when he said he would, and the service was fast, professional, and flawless. Even after pumping the tank, the issue in my house persisted. Instead of leaving, Jason went above and beyond the scope of the job and helped me dislodge a clog in the line running from my home to the septic tank. He didn’t charge anything extra for this—he was simply happy to help. Outstanding service, and I highly recommend Sidekick Septic.
